files.title: Festival Walk mall floor plates (3D)
files.notes: 7 translucent floor plates (MTR..2/F) plus a translucent podium. Each floor has its own footprint derived from that floor's route network buffered 14 m; the podium is the union of all floor footprints, extruded from -6 m up to the G floor (33.0 m) so the building is founded on the hillside. The G floor is set to Tat Chee Avenue at the mall junction - 33.0 m from Esri WorldElevation3D Terrain3D. Terrain under the footprint runs 18.9-35.2 m. Storey height 5.5 m is schematic; display heights are stretched 2x.

files.title: Festival Walk vertical circulation, 3D (lifts / escalators / stairs / ramps)
files.notes: 29 genuine floor-to-floor connectors, separated from the 48 flat site surfaces using the CSDI FeatureType domain and Gradient field. Each connector's two floors are resolved by matching its ends against the published floor networks (a connector's ends land at 0.00 m from the floor it serves). Carries floor_from, floor_to, mode (link / shaft / incline) and rise_m. The app draws each connector with a different z on each vertex, so lifts are vertical shafts and escalators slope between floors.

files.title: Festival Walk flat site surfaces (podium decks, traffic islands, crossings, footways)
files.notes: 48 flat surfaces from the CSDI routes that have no floor id and are NOT vertical circulation. They are outdoor podium decks, traffic islands, crossings and footways, which belong on the terrain rather than inside the building. Kept separate so they are not drawn as a flat mesh through the mall.

files.title: Landslide susceptibility cells (200 m polygons)
files.notes: One polygon per 200 m cell with the XGBoost susceptibility score, class and the key attributes (slope, elevation, weathering class). EPSG:2326 (HK1980). 5-fold spatial blocked CV, ROC-AUC 0.882.

files.title: Recorded landslide points
files.notes: CEDD Location of Landslide Incidents (10,854) + ENTLI historical crowns (113,166, 1924-2023). EPSG:2326 (HK1980).

files.title: Landslide susceptibility raster (model score)
files.notes: 240 x 318 at 200 m, float32, nodata -9999, EPSG:2326, with source and model tags.

files.title: Landslide susceptibility of Hong Kong - finalised map
files.notes: XGBoost on 200 m cells, terrain + land cover + weathering-susceptibility predictors, 5-fold spatial blocked CV (5 km blocks), ROC-AUC 0.882. Five equal-area quintiles of the model score.

files.title: Susceptibility score grid (browser data)
files.notes: 76,320 cell scores in a flat array plus class statistics and the fitted HK1980<->WGS84 affine transform (max residual 0.48 mm over 64 km).

files.title: Susceptibility class surface (browser overlay)
files.notes: Transparent PNG of the five susceptibility classes, 4 px per cell, georeferenced to the grid bounds.

files.title: Recorded landslide points overlay (browser)
